item.title: Assam: Train Hits Goods Vehicle at Railway Crossing in Tinsukia
item.description: A goods vehicle was severely damaged after it was hit by a moving train at a railway crossing in the Laipuli area of Tinsukia district in Assam on Saturday, March 7. Fortunately, the driver and the handyman of the vehicle managed to escape unharmed. According to reports, the incident occurred when the goods carrier attempted to cross the railway tracks at Laipuli. item.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah on Saturday inaugurated and laid the foundation stone for a series of development projects in Uttarakhand worth over Rs. 1,129 crore, marking the completion of four years of Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami’s government. item.title: Assam: Kumar Bhaskar Varma Bridge Opens for Light Vehicles Today
item.description: The Kumar Bhaskar Varma Bridge will open for the movement of two-wheelers and light vehicles from today. item.title: Assam: Three Dead After Passenger Van Plunges Off Road in Dima Hasao
item.description: Three people were killed, and four others after a passenger van plunged off the road in Assam’s Dima Hasao district on Saturday night. According to the reports, the accident took place at around 9:30 pm on the New Haflong Approach Road in the Boro Haflong area under Haflong Police Station. item.description: Ahead of the Jan Ashirwad Yatra today, Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma addressed the public through a special Facebook Live session, announcing that beneficiaries of the Orunodoi Scheme will receive a financial assistance of Rs 9,000 on March 10.
